name: Desert Survival Kits

narrative.details: With the arrival of fresh recruits to Cenarion Hold comes the problem of keeping them alive in the desert.  Dehydration as well as numerous poisonous creatures present a serious threat to inexperienced volunteers.  Gather the supplies necessary for a desert survival kit and bring them to Calandrath in Cenarion Hold.
narrative.objectives: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

giverName: an item: Logistics Task Briefing I
